activity_summary: At the Split Hazel supper was sixpence. A scarred gunner spread a greased chart of the Spanish Main and swore that every kitchen pot in Guiana was beaten gold. He had Davy's forty ships and the Queen's blessing. Kemp asked him, with great respect, why he was in Bishopsgate. Bryan said that anyone who truly knew the road to riches would go quietly. You said the loaf at home was a finger short, and that you had not counted the ships. Alice let the talk stay while it was still talk.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Named the short loaf and the uncounted ships, and stayed to listen.

entities.name: Alice Brambleby
entities.context: Charged sixpence and let the talk continue while doubt was still allowed.

entities.name: George Bryan
entities.context: Said a man who knew the road would go quietly.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Asked, with great respect, why the gunner was in Bishopsgate.

facets.activity: Heard the chart at the Split Hazel

quotes.speaker: george_bryan
quotes.text: Anyone who truly knew the road to riches would go quietly.

quotes.speaker: alice_brambleby
quotes.text: Sixpence the supper, Master Shakespeare, and the bread is the bread the City has.
